steps_basic.title: Create two backdrops
steps_basic.instruction: Create two backdrops: WAIT and GO (big text).
steps_basic.hint: Stage → Backdrops tab → use text tool (T) to add big text. WAIT (red), GO (green)

steps_basic.title: Start with WAIT
steps_basic.instruction: Events → when green flag clicked: switch backdrop to WAIT.
steps_basic.hint: Code on the STAGE, not a sprite.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]

steps_basic.title: Add random wait
steps_basic.hint: Control → wait ( ). Operators → pick random (1) to (5). Drag into wait block.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds

steps_basic.title: Reset timer and show GO
steps_basic.instruction: Sensing → reset timer. Switch backdrop to GO.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing → reset timer. Looks → switch backdrop to [GO]
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_basic.title: Capture reaction time
steps_basic.instruction: Events → when stage clicked: Looks → say (timer) for 2 seconds.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing → timer goes inside say block.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test reaction timer
steps_basic.instruction: Test: start, wait, click when GO appears; timer shows your reaction time.
steps_basic.hint: Don't click too early! Wait for backdrop to change to GO.

steps_standard.title: Do BASIC first
steps_standard.instruction: Complete BASIC level before starting STANDARD.
steps_standard.hint: You should have WAIT/GO backdrops, random wait, timer, click detection.

steps_standard.title: Make 'bestTime' variable
steps_standard.instruction: Variables → Make variable bestTime. Set bestTime to 999 on green flag.
steps_standard.hint: Set to high number so any real time beats it.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]

steps_standard.title: Make 'state' variable
steps_standard.instruction: Make variable state and set state to WAIT at start; set state to GO when backdrop switches to GO.
steps_standard.hint: Tracks whether we're in WAIT or GO phase.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [state v] to [WAIT]
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
set [state v] to [GO]
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_standard.title: Add anti-cheat check
steps_standard.instruction: Stage clicked: if state = WAIT then say 'Too early!' and do not update bestTime.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early! Wait for GO!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Update best time
steps_standard.instruction: If state = GO: if timer < bestTime then set bestTime to timer.
steps_standard.hint: Only update if in GO state AND time is better.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds
  if <(timer) < (bestTime)> then
    set [bestTime v] to (timer)

steps_standard.title: Show bestTime on stage
steps_standard.instruction: Show bestTime on stage and test improvement.
steps_standard.hint: Check checkbox next to bestTime variable.

steps_advanced.title: Do STANDARD first
steps_advanced.instruction: Complete STANDARD level before starting ADVANCED.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have WAIT/GO, state, bestTime, anti-cheat.

steps_advanced.title: Make round and total variables
steps_advanced.instruction: Variables → Make variables round and total. Set round=0 and total=0 on green flag.
steps_advanced.hint: These track rounds and total time.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)

steps_advanced.title: Create 3-round loop
steps_advanced.instruction: Repeat 3: set state WAIT; switch backdrop WAIT; wait random 1–5; reset timer; set state GO; switch backdrop GO; wait for click.
steps_advanced.hint: Control → repeat (3). Use 'wait until <mouse down?>' to wait for click.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
repeat (3)
  set [state v] to [WAIT]
  switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
  wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
  reset timer
  set [state v] to [GO]
  switch backdrop to [GO v]
  wait until <mouse down?>
  change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Add time to total
steps_advanced.instruction: Add captured time to total; change round by 1.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
wait until <mouse down?>
change [total v] by (timer)
change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Calculate average
steps_advanced.instruction: After 3 rounds: compute average = total / 3 (use Operators). Say 'Average: (average)'.
steps_advanced.hint: Operators → (total) / (3). Use join to show message.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
after repeat (3):
set [average v] to ((total) / (3))
say (join [Average: ] (average)) for (3) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Add Restart button (optional)
steps_advanced.instruction: Create Restart button sprite: when clicked broadcast RESTART. Stage: on receive RESTART reset and rerun.
steps_advanced.hint: New sprite → when clicked → broadcast RESTART
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
Restart sprite:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [RESTART v]

Stage:
when I receive [RESTART v]
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)
[run the game]
